title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.27 - Tag Team now pays the player who played it. Marking an enemy so a teammate's next attack hits twice was worth nothing on the meter beyond the card's own 11: the extra attack is a whole extra hit rather than a bigger one, so all of it was booked to the teammate who swung it. Both the damage and the block of that bought play now go to you, while any other teammate's buffs on the same hit keep exactly what they were worth. Underworld was checked over after a report and is credited correctly - the Doom it makes out of a teammate's damage belongs to whoever played Underworld, and the kill pays them the health it removes. Verified against game v0.111.0; still works on v0.107.1 and later.
